prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create A02 BALEEN FILTER, one finished ORIGINAL hand-painted 2D side-scrolling room concept. Image 1 is the old room layout/style reference. Image 2 is the newly refined neighboring entry room: match its palette, wet muted rose tissue, matte ivory root bone, deep blue enormous opposite jaw, tapered cream baleen, ecological detail and painterly finish. New composition, not collage.
The room must be a THREE-WAY JUNCTION within one natural whale mouth. MAIN ROUTE is an unbroken low rolling mandibular ledge across the bottom 2/3 height; enter OPEN left edge at low level, pass ONE small bone-shell scavenger crab on center-left mound, leave OPEN right beneath a diagonal jaw buttress. This SAME diagonal buttress seen in neighboring room continues in medium distance. No identical round portals. Path has thick asymmetrical support roots joining the lower mass, clusters of sea growth around joints and clear uncluttered foot surfaces.
Two optional elevated directions: far LEFT wall slopes upward on three differently shaped wall-rooted shelves into an OLD SKULL-SIDE WOUND crevice; this is the future float route around the solid hard palate to dorsal nose. At upper RIGHT, TWO small fixed worn bone tether rings wrapped in muted RED cord lead to a narrow dark lateral baleen-root MEMBRANE POUCH entrance. Make that entrance a folded slit, not another circular gate. These two upper branches do not meet in this painting. The hard palate overhead is a solid thick bone plate; no open vertical shortcut through the skull. Long hanging ivory baleen descends from upper jaw center-right, uneven filaments, one illuminated curtain and one shadowed; no teeth.
Tiny original diver at lower left, single round dark lens on ivory rounded helmet, teal short cape, U-shaped TWO-prong resonator and amber enclosed lamp. Deep water has distant sparse fish silhouette school, a few rising bubble groups, broad quiet dark intervals. Far jaw arches huge and low contrast, not rows of identical oval holes. Upper light comes through distant tissue break, cyan scattered water glow not harsh sun rays. Dark soft-focused lower foreground coral does not block the road. One sealed amber biological lamp on a natural niche, no fire.
Wide 16:9 side elevation, clear playable silhouettes and rich atmospheric depth. No HUD, words, numbers, arrows, borders, diagram panels. No insect kingdom, horned mask, knight, sword/nail, masonry, floating unsupported repeated slabs. All anatomy belongs to a dead whale; no active breathing or sea surface.
